Page 28 Cont.
Apr. 28 Thanks - Andrew F. Ford - 6 - threatening condition of ears for quite some months; Enrolled 2 week To-day, now quite cleared up. Hopes now that operation may be entirely averted.
Andrew Lagru - 67 - Bay City - Fearful case of vericose veins ... phones .. .
28 Ed. Andursh - 4 - operation To-day for tuomer on brain.
Mrs. M. Lawton - 74 - stomach cancer - Drs have no hope of recovery . . Enrolled before ... but To-night perpetually
Carol Randoll - 11 - asthma ...
Page 29
1942, May
May 1 Jean Ross - 13 - dermatomyositis a very rare and peculiar disease - has now been home from school 2 yrs. Drs at sea what to do ... Enrolled To-day 1.00
1 Baby Mary-Ann Hofmeyer - 13 mo. - fever after pneumonia a couple week ago.
2 Mrs. Dantzer has two soldier sons - last week 50,000 soldiers were shipped away - "no one knowing whither."
3 Mrs. Mary Isob. Reddy - 56 - Stroke Apr. 26 - unconscious most of the time, though slowly improving since enrolled last Sunday
5 Chas. Pat. O'Rourke - 35 - accident - loss of right Eye almost cer- tain. Only miracle can save it .. Resigned ... Enrolled Today - 50¢ ... promising
6 Ed Dewitt - 22 - missing since last Friday - fear boy has been drown'd
6 Harry Cameron - 47 - intestinal trouble ....
8 Mrs. Mary Miller - 73 - Lutheran - rheumatism. . . Enrolled this a.m ....
Page 30
May 10 Leo Weyer - Sandusky, 0. - 21 - accident in 1938 .... had leg smashed . . . has been doctoring ever since about #2000.00 - still no improve- ment .... Enrolled To-day 1.00
11 Shirly Ann Gundick - 13 - epileptic and feeble-minded - becoming un- maneg .. ..
